title: 对亚洲母亲无所不能的刻板印象(5)
desc: 对亚洲母亲无所不能的刻板印象(5)

paragraphs.en: As adults, most of my friends have taken the path of least resistance: by hiding what they can.
paragraphs.zh: 成年之后，我大部分朋友都选择阻力最小的方式：尽可能隐瞒。

paragraphs.en: In her memoir, Amy Chua compares the work of tiger motherhood to being a military leader, in which targeted action is combined with constant secret scheming.
paragraphs.zh: 蔡美儿在回忆录中将虎妈育儿比作军队统帅，精准施压，同时不断暗中筹谋。

paragraphs.en: She doesn't note that children soon learn this game, too. New partners are introduced as roommates.
paragraphs.zh: 但她没有提到，孩子很快也学会这套游戏。新交往的伴侣被介绍成室友。

paragraphs.en: Appearances are maintained. None of this is surprising, given the stakes.
paragraphs.zh: 维持体面表象。考虑其中利害，这一切并不意外。

paragraphs.en: Once, when a friend's sister got a new boyfriend, their mum hired a private investigator to look into him.
paragraphs.zh: 曾经，我一位朋友的姐姐交了新男友，她们的母亲雇私家侦探调查对方。

paragraphs.en: The boyfriend wasn't dodgy. The mum simply didn't like him.
paragraphs.zh: 这个男友并无问题。母亲只是单纯不喜欢他。

paragraphs.en: In retaliation, my friend's sister moved out and refused to tell her mother her new address.
paragraphs.zh: 作为反抗，朋友的姐姐搬了出去，不肯告诉母亲新住址。

paragraphs.en: I'm not immune to all this deception and evasion.
paragraphs.zh: 我也无法免于这类隐瞒与回避。

paragraphs.en: Only recently did I, at age 31, tell my mum about my college boyfriends.
paragraphs.zh: 直到最近，31岁的我，才告诉妈妈大学时期交往过的男友。

paragraphs.en: If our mothers conform to certain cliches, the same is true of my own generation.
paragraphs.zh: 倘若我们的母亲身上带着某些刻板印象，我们这一代人同样如此。

paragraphs.en: My conversations with friends are peppered with references to therapy: revelations had, boundaries enacted, trauma inherited, the allure of closure.
paragraphs.zh: 我和朋友们聊天时，总会频繁提到心理咨询：那些内心的顿悟、立下的边界、代代传承的创伤，还有对与过往和解的向往。

paragraphs.en: We have been raised on films that end with cathartic tears and hugs, and promises never to hurt each other again.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从小看的电影，结局往往是人们痛哭释怀、相拥在一起，承诺再也不会伤害彼此。

paragraphs.en: In real life, that's not where most of my friends are with their mothers.
paragraphs.zh: 但现实生活里，我的大多数朋友和母亲之间，并不是这样。

paragraphs.en: Here are some of the things they say:  "Moving abroad has definitely improved our relationship. I can take her in doses. That's pretty much it."
paragraphs.zh: 下面是她们说的一些话：“移居国外确实改善了我们的关系。我可以阶段性和她相处。仅此而已。”

paragraphs.en: "Our relationship is alright. It's not quite satisfactory. It's alright. I have much more respect and reverence for all that she has endured. And I try to bear that in mind as much as possible."
paragraphs.zh: “我们的关系还算可以，算不上满意，只能说还行。我更加敬重她经历的一切苦难，并且尽可能把这点放在心上。”

paragraphs.en: "I would say I have a good relationship with her.
paragraphs.zh: “我觉得我和她关系不错。

paragraphs.en: From my mum's perspective, she thinks we're closer than ever, she thinks we're best friends. And that's because I share much less now."
paragraphs.zh: 在我妈妈看来，她认为我们比以往任何时候都亲近，她觉得我们是最好的朋友。而这其实是因为我现在很少向她袒露心事。”

paragraphs.en: "I went to therapy for the first time and gained a much more varied vocabulary and understanding of my emotional landscape, my boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: “我第一次做心理咨询，学会了更丰富的词汇，也更懂自己的情绪状态，懂得设立边界。

paragraphs.en: And my mum, to her credit, had the humility to not demand that she was always right. She was open to learning that from me.
paragraphs.zh: 值得肯定的是，我母亲足够谦逊，不会强求自己永远是对的。她愿意从我这里学习这些道理。

paragraphs.en: And when I would say, like: 'Why do you say that? Why are you blowing up for no reason on this?' She was willing to learn."
paragraphs.zh: 当我问她：‘你为什么要这么说？为什么无缘无故发火？’她愿意去反思。”

paragraphs.en: "I manage something that I don't know how to deal with, basically. I feel sad for me but also for her.
paragraphs.zh: “基本上，这段关系我只能勉强维持，我不知道该怎么处理。我既为自己难过，也为她难过。

paragraphs.en: I don't have anyone who could be a parent figure because I can't really rely on her to give career or relationship advice.
paragraphs.zh: 我没有可以充当人生长辈的依靠，因为没法指望她给我职业或者感情上的建议。

paragraphs.en: It's really sad because, at the end of the day, her kids are the most important thing to her.
paragraphs.zh: 真的很让人难过，说到底，孩子是她生命里最重要的东西。

paragraphs.en: But I'm avoiding her. My sibling is at best being civil to her.
paragraphs.zh: 但我在刻意回避她。我的兄弟姐妹最多只是和她维持表面礼貌。

paragraphs.en: Both of us think that she's been dealt a bad hand. But equally, we are not invested."
paragraphs.zh: 我们俩都觉得她命不好。但同样，我们也不会再投入情感。”

paragraphs.en: Hollywood endings can feel so remote in real life.
paragraphs.zh: 好莱坞式圆满结局在现实中显得如此遥远。

paragraphs.en: No wonder the mother-daughter relationships have proved such fertile ground in art.
paragraphs.zh: 难怪母女关系会成为艺术创作一片沃土。

paragraphs.en: Often, they are a way to imagine the impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 很多时候，这些作品是在想象那些不可能实现的和解。

paragraphs.en: "Is that why I am writing this, so I can remember my mother fondly?" Jen wonders aloud in Bad Bad Girl. "Is that the same as forgiving her?"
paragraphs.zh: “我写下这些，是不是为了能温柔地怀念我的母亲吗？”任璧莲在《坏坏女孩》中这样自问。“这是否等同于原谅她？”
